svg.text: parity — x is the bit stream, y is the running XOR
every shaded x = 1 flips the label; runs of 0s hold it — chance 0.5
S3 — x is a stream of group elements, y is the running composition
y[t] = x[t] ∘ y[t−1] — e.g. t2: 5 ∘ 1 = 2; t4: 2 ∘ 2 = 0 (back to identity) — chance ≈ 1/6
verbatim from probes.py: make_parity / make_s3 (batch=128, T=64),
seed-0 training stream (torch.Generator().manual_seed(1)), batch row 0, first steps of 64
